title: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(4)
desc: 深谈中国的机器人革命内情(4)

paragraphs.en: If you have seen a Chinese robot dance or do kung fu, chances are it was made by Unitree.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你见过国产机器人跳舞、表演武术，那它很有可能出自宇树科技。

paragraphs.en: Last year, the company shipped more than 5,500 humanoid robots, more than any company in the world.
paragraphs.zh: 去年，这家企业出货人形机器人超5500台，全球出货量位居行业第一。

paragraphs.en: Recently, a viral video appeared showing a concert by the Chinese pop star Wang Leehom in Chengdu, where Unitree robots served as backup dancers.
paragraphs.zh: 此前一段视频在网络走红，内容是中国流行歌手王力宏在成都举办演唱会，宇树机器人充当伴舞。

paragraphs.en: Elon Musk reposted it with a single word: "Impressive."
paragraphs.zh: 埃隆·马斯克转发了这条视频，只配了一个词：“令人惊叹。”

paragraphs.en: The viral performances serve as good marketing for China.
paragraphs.zh: 这类刷屏的表演为中国机器人产业带来了极佳的宣传效果。

paragraphs.en: But Unitree's main customers are labs and universities, including Oxford, Carnegie Mellon, UC San Diego and Boston Dynamics, which buy the robot and develop software to make them more intelligent.
paragraphs.zh: 但宇树的核心客户是各大实验室与高校，包括牛津大学、卡内基梅隆大学、加州大学圣地亚哥分校，还有波士顿动力。这些机构采购其硬件，自主开发配套软件提升机器人智能水平。

paragraphs.en: A spokesperson told me Unitree wants their robots to eventually enter factories and homes so they can "take on dangerous, repetitive, and tedious work for people".
paragraphs.zh: 一位企业发言人向我表示，宇树的长远目标是让机器人走进工厂与家庭，替人类承担危险、重复、枯燥的工作。

paragraphs.en: Late one evening, I was in a cab in the city of Ningbo, when I got a message from a Unitree spokesperson.
paragraphs.zh: 一天深夜，我正在宁波的出租车上，收到了宇树公关人员发来的消息。

paragraphs.en: We had planned to meet at their headquarters in Hangzhou, about an hour by train, the next morning, but the company had abruptly scheduled an "important event" for tomorrow that would shut down all the roads near the office.
paragraphs.zh: 我们原本约好次日上午前往位于杭州的企业总部会面，车程一小时左右，但公司临时通知次日将举办一场“重要活动”，办公楼周边所有道路临时管控封闭。

paragraphs.en: There are not many things in China that can stop traffic and bend corporate timelines.
paragraphs.zh: 在中国，能临时封路、调整企业日程的事情并不多见。

paragraphs.en: I checked my phone to see where President Xi Jinping was: two days ago, he had attended a sporting event in Guangzhou, but it wasn't clear where he was heading next.
paragraphs.zh: 我打开手机查看习近平总书记行程：两天前他在广州出席体育活动，无法判断他接下来的到访地点。

paragraphs.en: The spokesperson asked if I could come tonight. I looked at the time – it was already 7.32pm.
paragraphs.zh: 公关人员询问我能否当晚过去。我看了一眼时间，已经晚上七点三十二分。

paragraphs.en: "We'll be here," she assured me. I rushed to the train station.
paragraphs.zh: “我们这边会全程等候。”对方向我保证。我立刻赶往火车站。

paragraphs.en: Despite its global stature, Unitree's headquarters are shockingly modest.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然在全球业内声名远扬，宇树的总部却朴素得超乎想象。

paragraphs.en: The company occupies two weathered buildings in Hangzhou's tech district, inside an old compound flanked by auto dealers and mom-and-pop stores.
paragraphs.zh: 公司坐落于杭州科创片区两栋老旧楼房内，园区年代久远，两侧分布着汽车经销商与小型个体户商铺。

paragraphs.en: When I arrived, around 9pm, most of the Unitree employees were only just getting off work.
paragraphs.zh: 我抵达时大约晚上九点，大部分员工才刚下班。

paragraphs.en: I was greeted by three media representatives who ferried me to a display area where an array of robots awaited me.
paragraphs.zh: 三名公关工作人员接待了我，带我前往展示区，各类机器人整齐陈列。

paragraphs.en: One wore a purple boxing helmet and was throwing combinations with an intensity that made me take an instinctive step back.
paragraphs.zh: 一台机器人戴着紫色拳击护头，连续打出组合拳，力度十足，我下意识后退了一步。

paragraphs.en: Another was dancing the charleston.
paragraphs.zh: 另一台机器人正在跳查尔斯顿复古舞。

paragraphs.en: Next, a four-legged robot dog cycled through flips and tricks.
paragraphs.zh: 旁边的四足机器狗接连完成空翻、特技动作。

paragraphs.en: All the while, the demonstrators kept kicking the robots, hard.
paragraphs.zh: 演示人员全程用力踢踹机器人机身。

paragraphs.en: The robots absorbed every blow, and never toppled over.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人稳稳承受每一次撞击，始终没有摔倒。

paragraphs.en: One developer at Boston Dynamics, an American competitor, told me that Unitree's hardware is highly advanced and remarkably cheap.
paragraphs.zh: 来自美国竞品企业波士顿动力的一名研发人员告诉我，宇树的硬件技术十分先进，定价却格外低廉。

paragraphs.en: Their robots start at about $1,600, while comparable American machines cost tens of thousands of dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 该品牌机器人起售价仅约1600美元，而同类美国设备动辄数万美元。

paragraphs.en: The Boston Dynamics developer attributed Unitree's advantage to structural conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 这位波士顿动力研发人员认为，宇树的成本优势源于国内独特产业环境。

paragraphs.en: China has two sprawling metropolitan areas – the Yangtze River Delta near Shanghai, and the Pearl River Delta in Shenzhen – which are home to a hive of hardware suppliers so dense that robot-makers can sometimes walk next door for a replacement part.
paragraphs.zh: 中国拥有两大产业集群带：上海周边的长三角、深圳所在的珠三角，聚集了海量硬件配套供应商，密度极高，机器人厂商有时隔壁门店就能配齐替换零部件。

paragraphs.en: Tweaking a robot prototype can take less than a day in Shenzhen, but weeks in Silicon Valley, where parts may need to cross multiple states or oceans.
paragraphs.zh: 在深圳，调整机器人原型机可能一天就能完成；而硅谷需要跨多州甚至跨国调货，耗时数周。

paragraphs.en: The ease of building also explains why there are 330 different types of humanoid robots in China.
paragraphs.zh: 零部件配套便捷，也是国内涌现出330款不同人形机器人的原因。

paragraphs.en: It makes creative destruction into a normal part of the process.
paragraphs.zh: 快速迭代试错、淘汰不合格方案，已经成为行业常态。

paragraphs.en: "We commercialise one generation of robots," said Harry Xu, a robotics entrepreneur and researcher at Tsinghua University.
paragraphs.zh: “我们推出一代商用机器人，”清华大学机器人领域创业者、研究员徐哈里说道。

paragraphs.en: Many of that generation inevitably fail. "Then we build the next generation."
paragraphs.zh: 这一代产品里必然会有大量型号被市场淘汰。“之后我们再研发下一代。”

paragraphs.en: Another way to think about the humanoid robotics industry in the US and China is as a spectrum.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以把中美人形机器人产业看作一条发展光谱。

paragraphs.en: At one end sits the general-purpose humanoid, the sci-fi vision of a machine that can do anything a human can do.
paragraphs.zh: 光谱一端是通用人形机器人，也就是科幻作品里那种能完成人类所有工作的终极机型。

paragraphs.en: At the other end is a robot trained to do one thing extremely well, sacrificing breadth for commercial reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 另一端是专精单一任务的机器人，牺牲多功能性，换取商业化落地的稳定可靠。

paragraphs.en: For all sorts of reasons – the pressure to commercialise, the pull of government contracts, the intense competition that rewards differentiation and profit over research – companies in China get dragged to the modest side.
paragraphs.zh: 受多重因素影响——商业化落地压力、政府项目订单、激烈行业竞争倒逼企业优先做出差异化产品与盈利，国内企业大多偏向务实路线，深耕专用型机器人。

paragraphs.en: The biggest American tech companies, insulated by deeper venture capital and less commercial urgency, tend to aim for the grail.
paragraphs.zh: 美国头部科技企业手握充足风投资金，商业化落地压力更小，更倾向研发通用型机器人这一终极目标。

paragraphs.en: A plausible future is one where the US leads the technology toward the generalised humanoid, and China supplies the world with cheap, reliable robots that each do one thing very well.
paragraphs.zh: 一种合理的未来发展格局是：美国主导通用人形机器人核心技术研发，而中国向全球供应性价比高、稳定可靠的专用机器人。

paragraphs.en: The US may eventually produce a single robot that can mow your lawn, walk your dog and babysit your children.
paragraphs.zh: 未来美国或许能造出一台全能机器人，割草、遛狗、照看孩子样样精通。

paragraphs.en: But while you wait, you might as well buy three Chinese ones that can do one task each, at a fraction of the price.
paragraphs.zh: 但在这款全能机器人问世之前，消费者完全可以买三台中国机器人，每台各司其职，总价却只是前者的零头。

paragraphs.en: The morning after my visit, I took a cab back to Unitree's offices to see what the activity was.
paragraphs.zh: 拜访结束次日上午，我打车重返宇树总部，想弄清前一日临时管控活动的具体内容。

paragraphs.en: The block around the perimeter had been cordoned off.
paragraphs.zh: 整片街区外围全部拉起警戒线。

paragraphs.en: I hopped out of the cab and walked about a block to Unitree's front gate, where three suited men stood guard outside, scanning each passerby.
paragraphs.zh: 我下车步行一个街区走到宇树大门，三名身着正装的工作人员在外值守，对每一位路人进行查验。

paragraphs.en: Beyond three black public security vans, I couldn't see anything.
paragraphs.zh: 大门内侧停放三辆黑色公安执勤车，内部场景完全无法看清。

paragraphs.en: I checked my phone and saw that Xi Jinping was 750 miles away in Beijing, hosting a visit from King Felipe VI of Spain.
paragraphs.zh: 我翻看手机新闻，得知习近平总书记此时身在750英里外的北京，正在接待西班牙国王费利佩六世访华。

paragraphs.en: I crossed the street and hailed another cab.
paragraphs.zh: 我穿过马路拦下另一辆出租车。

paragraphs.en: When I got inside, the driver was curious to know whether I had seen anything outside the factory.
paragraphs.zh: 上车后，司机好奇地问我在厂区外有没有看到什么特殊情况。

paragraphs.en: He had just dropped off a Unitree employee and was quick to speculate.
paragraphs.zh: 他刚送完一名宇树员工下班，随口做出猜测。

paragraphs.en: "There must be an army group inside." His guess was a reasonable one.
paragraphs.zh: “里面肯定有部队过来视察。”这个猜测并非毫无依据。

paragraphs.en: Two years ago, Chinese state TV broadcast footage of Chinese military drills that showed Unitree robot dogs equipped with machine guns.
paragraphs.zh: 两年前，央视军事节目播出演习画面，视频里宇树机器狗搭载了机枪装备。

paragraphs.en: American lawmakers have suggested that Unitree be cut off from US technologies such as semiconductors.
paragraphs.zh: 美国国会议员曾提议切断宇树获取半导体等美国技术的渠道。

paragraphs.en: Unitree maintains it does not sell to the military, nor does it endorse military modifications from third parties, but one US-based analytics firm says that Unitree sells to Chinese universities that contract with the military.
paragraphs.zh: 宇树方面表示，公司不向军方直接出售产品，也不认可第三方对自家机器人进行军用改装；但一家美国分析机构称，宇树产品流向了与军方存在合作项目的国内高校。

paragraphs.en: The scrutiny has affected the robotics industry in China.
paragraphs.zh: 这类外部审查给国内机器人行业带来了影响。

paragraphs.en: A spokesperson at a top robotics company told me that they had been warned by authorities not to talk to western media.
paragraphs.zh: 一家头部机器人企业的公关人员透露，相关部门已提醒企业谨慎接受境外媒体采访。

paragraphs.en: When I asked Unitree's spokespeople who the company's customers were and whether it sold more robots overseas or in China, they replied tersely: "We do both."
paragraphs.zh: 我向宇树公关询问企业客户构成、海外与国内市场销量对比，对方答复十分简略：“海内外市场均有布局。”

paragraphs.en: When I contacted the company later, Unitree told me the security presence had no relation to the military: it was a government delegation that had come to learn more about robots.
paragraphs.zh: 后续我再次联系企业，宇树称当日安保管控与军方无关，是政府考察团前来调研机器人产业。
